headline: Endpoints News has published an interview with Paulo Fontoura, Sanofi's new head of research and development, on AI, drug failure rates and dealmaking.
score_reason: Pool 5, lowered to 4: only the headline and a one-sentence teaser are known, the answers could not be checked.
importance_line: Where a large drugmaker's research chief stands on AI and deals matters to patients waiting for new medicines and then to investors and rival drugmakers, but what Fontoura actually said is not yet known.
summary: Endpoints News published a question-and-answer interview with Paulo Fontoura, who became global head of research and development at the French drugmaker Sanofi in September after 16 years at Roche and a recent period at an AI drug discovery company, on AI, R&D failure rates and dealmaking.
